reviews.body: Copilot was unable to review this pull request because the user who requested the review has reached their quota limit.

Requesting changes. The KAN-78 occupied-interval design looks sound: setup/turnaround are applied consistently in search, calendar, submission and approval, checks run after the venue-row lock, and existing bookings get warnings instead of being moved or cancelled. CI on the branch passes. But the branch is behind `main` and can't merge as it stands. **Disclosure:** I wrote KAN-81 (#47, merged; #49 and #50 open), which is the code most of this collides with, so please weigh points 1â€“3 with that in mind.

### Blocking

**1. Migration number collision.** `main` already has `database/migrations/010_venue_outage_impacts.sql` (#47), and #50 adds `011_venue_booking_replacements.sql`. `010_venue_occupied_intervals.sql` has to be renumbered to the next free number when this is rebased: 011 if this merges before #50, otherwise 012. The migration lists in `database/tests/database.integration.test.ts` need the same update; that file is one of the conflicts. Can we agree the merge order in the group chat so only one of us renumbers?

**2. The new block trigger reverses KAN-81 AC1.** `prevent_blocking_occupied_booking` (`010_venue_occupied_intervals.sql:99-112`) raises whenever a block overlaps an approved booking. Since #47, `main` deliberately allows Venue Staff to record an outage over approved bookings. It flags them as `RECOVERY_REQUIRED` instead of refusing (`block-service.ts` and `outage-impact.ts`). With this trigger, every outage over an approved booking fails at the database, and the KAN-81 integration suite (`venue-outage-recovery.integration.test.ts`) will fail. Suggested fix: keep only the venue-row `FOR UPDATE` lock in the trigger, or drop the trigger. The application path already takes that lock.

**3. `block-service.ts` conflict.** This branch edits the approved-booking clash query in `createVenueBlock`, but `main` removed that refusal in #47. On rebase, please keep `main`'s version (no refusal). Then swap KAN-81's affected-booking rule to occupied intervals. It was written as the KAN-78 swap point: `AFFECTED_BOOKING_CONDITION` in `backend/src/modules/venues/outage-impact.ts` currently compares raw `b.starts_at`/`b.ends_at`. Switching it to `venue_booking_intervals` (`occupied_starts_at`/`occupied_ends_at`) means an outage covering only a booking's setup or turnaround also flags it. The KAN-81 tests and the TC-09-xx records would need a buffered case.

**4. Reused run IDs.** The evidence uses `AUTO-20261021-01` and `AUTO-20261021-02` (in `test-evidence.md` and the `evidence/AUTO-20261021-01-*.txt` / `-02-*` files), but `main` already uses both IDs for other stories. Lines 859, 975 and 1072â€“1162 of `main`'s `test-evidence.md` show the earlier collisions being qualified as `AUTO-20261021-KAN52-01`, `-KAN6-02` and `-KAN77-02`. Please qualify these the same way, e.g. `AUTO-20261021-KAN78-01/02`. `-90` doesn't collide.

**5. Resolve the remaining conflicts.** These are `database/README.md` (migration sequence), `api-contract.md`, `product-backlog.md`, `evidence/README.md`, `test-cases.csv`, `test-evidence.md`, `test-executions.csv` and `erd-planning.png`. The TC-03-30x/TC-14-30x and EX-* IDs don't collide with `main`, so the CSV conflicts are only append positions. Please keep both sides. `erd-planning.png` needs re-exporting from the merged Mermaid source, because `main`'s version includes `VENUE_OUTAGE_IMPACTS`, and #50 adds `replaces_booking_id`. The settings recorded in #47 were Mermaid CLI 12.0.0, neutral theme, white background, `--size 2600`, scale 2.

### Should fix

**6. Staff queue and KAN-81 recovery.** `listVenueBookings` (`booking-service.ts:86`) now shows Venue Staff every APPROVED booking that has warnings. After a KAN-81 outage, every affected booking carries `OPERATIONAL_BLOCK_OVERLAP`, so it shows up in the pending-decision queue until a replacement is approved. Staff can't decide an approved booking there. Either leave `OPERATIONAL_BLOCK_OVERLAP` out of the queue filter (KAN-81 already surfaces those through `GET /api/venues/recovery`), or label these rows clearly as "needs attention" rather than awaiting decision. If you change this, the AC wording should go in the decision log.

**7. Phase 3 interaction (only if #50 merges first).** Replacement requests use the same request and approval checks, so they'll pick up `assertOccupiedIntervalAvailable` automatically. But #50's `assertObjectivelySuitable` checks opening hours on event times through `isOpenForRange`. Once buffers apply, that check should use the occupied interval, or it can be dropped because your check already covers hours. Whichever PR merges second should reconcile this.

### Minor
- `venue_booking_warnings(b.id)` runs per row in both the staff list and the calendar. It's fine at our data size; just noting it in case the queue grows.

After the rebase, please re-run integration and e2e on the merged tree, record the new run, and re-request review. I'll re-review promptly.

Approved and reviewed by Irfan (member 1, PO) as part of the sprint 3 integration in #54.

@NahIts-Leo, your requested changes are applied in #54:
1. Migration renumbered to `012_venue_occupied_intervals.sql`, after KAN-81's 010 and 011.
2. `prevent_blocking_occupied_booking` now only takes the venue lock. KAN-81 outages over approved bookings are saved and flagged, and `venue-outage-recovery.integration.test.ts` passes.
3. `createVenueBlock` keeps main's no-refusal path. `AFFECTED_BOOKING_CONDITION` now reads `venue_booking_intervals`. The KAN-78 buffer test now expects a turnaround-only outage to be saved and the booking flagged.
4. Run IDs are qualified as `AUTO-20261021-KAN78-01/02`, and the evidence files are renamed too.
5. Conflicts are resolved keeping both sides. `erd-planning.png` keeps main's export because the Mermaid CLI was not available, so a combined re-export is still pending.
6. The staff queue leaves out approved bookings whose only warning is `OPERATIONAL_BLOCK_OVERLAP`.
7. Replacement suitability runs before the buffered check.

KAN-83 holds now reserve the buffered interval: migration 013 extends your trigger with live holds. Please re-review #54 after merge, or dismiss your earlier review if you are satisfied. CI run [39750396624](https://github.com/MochaLxtte/ConnectSphere/actions/runs/39750396624) on the combined branch passed: 759 frontend and 1,354 backend unit tests, migrations 001â€“013 on PostgreSQL 17, 479 integration tests and 156 browser tests.

Review method: AI-assisted (Claude), directed by Irfan. The diff was read in full while resolving it against the other Sprint 3 PRs, the PR template was checked, and the combined build was tested. Not checked: manual or hosted acceptance of the ACs; that stays with the story owner before the card moves to Done.
